label: EWSR1::PATZ1

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
PATZ1 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator with an AT-hook DNA-binding motif.

The fusion combines EWSR1 activation sequences with PATZ1 DNA-binding/regulatory regions. Reported sarcomas often show mixed neural, myogenic or epithelial marker expression and are distinct from conventional Ewing sarcoma.
